default.reason: no table entry; anything not in the table stops and escalates

rejected.meaning: ran cleanly, gate not cleared - a RESULT, not an error
rejected.note: the experiment answered no; retrying re-runs a question already answered

inconclusive.meaning: ran, gate could not be evaluated
inconclusive.note: retryable only after a fix; a bare re-run reproduces the same non-evaluation

infra_failed.meaning: the environment died under the job
infra_failed.note: MEASURED 2026-09-07: exitcode -1 / podman context deadline exceeded hit 5 job types across 4 PRs, every one needing a re-run

refused.meaning: a fail-closed guard prevented start - the guard working
refused.note: NEVER file under failure; filing a refusal as a failure trains the operator to ignore the signal guards exist to produce

on_cap.reason: infrastructure that fails twice in the same place probably is not infrastructure

no_pass_in_k_runs.reason: no passed outcome in K consecutive runs is evidence the setup is wrong, not that the work is hard

all_arms_passed.reason: every arm passing usually means the gate is not discriminating, exactly as G29 does today

margin_trend_growing.reason: a gate failing by a GROWING margin is regression; only the sequence shows which

severity_bands.name: marginal
severity_bands.note: |margin| within one seed spread - cannot discriminate

margin.note: the margin is the severity; a bare verdict discards it, and a shrinking margin across runs is progress that reads as another FAIL

members.runner.exitcode_minus_one: MEASURED 2026-09-07: 5 distinct job types across 3 PRs, every one needing a re-run, none a code change
members.runner.context_deadline_exceeded: MEASURED 2026-09-07: podman socket deadline; same class as exitcode -1
members.pytest.failures_block_named_test: structurally distinguishable from infra: a real assertion has a FAILURES block, a lost container does not
members.checkpoint_sha256_mismatch_same_seed: MEASURED: 11 distinct checkpoints across thread pins at one seed - the pin is missing or wrong
members.margin_over_per_item_spread: MEASURED exactly scale-invariant under logit scaling x1/x10/x100
members.update_norm_ratio: online plasticity proxy, computable during the run
members.mi_with_null: the null is what makes it a measurement

members.G29.verdict: MEASURED: passes on 3 of 4 seeds and 3 of 4 thread pins in an arm whose MI is exactly zero; flips on thread count alone
members.G35.verdict: MEASURED: 0.00-10.94 point seed spread against a 5.00 ceiling; train operand 1.0 in all 147 runs. Consume the margin, never the verdict
members.mean_a_store: MEASURED decoupled from information - random-walks, verdict independent of MI
members.design_doc_status_column: MEASURED unreliable: E1 marked todo while already merged
members.agent_self_reported_success: MEASURED 2026-09-07: an agent reported success while git worktree add had failed. Verify the external effect

members.recall_at_1: step function of continuous scores; report, never gate
members.conventions_lint_ci_failure: one died with exitcode -1 after cz check printed success; re-run once before believing it
members.ci_status_stale_after_retrigger: MEASURED 2026-09-07: a PR status was read as resolved from stale entries after a retrigger, and a concurrency cancel-in-progress files "Has been cancelled" as a failure. Read the CURRENT head's run, never a superseded one
members.single_seed_result: replicate on the seed axis; the thread axis is a nuisance parameter to pin away

members.loss_barrier: retrospective - knowable only after both branches train out; belongs in audit:, never shift:
members.fisher_trace_peak: pending evidence on whether it is detectable online (g56)

members.task_loss_stalling_high_accuracy: MEASURED shortcut signature (0.757 vs ~0.55 with accuracy 1.000); the loop should not rationalise it
members.two_consecutive_infra_failed_same_stage: infrastructure that fails twice in the same place is probably not infrastructure
members.policy_lookup_miss: a lookup MISS is not evidence of absence; it never licenses improvisation

classifiers.note: ordered; first rule with a match wins. Patterns are lowercase substrings matched against the failure text. Hard infra signatures run BEFORE the result rules because they are measured to mean infra even when the log also carries earlier assertion text (a conventions job died with exitcode -1 after cz check had printed success).

rules.why: a fail-closed guard prevented start - this is the guard working, not a failure

any: cannot connect to the docker daemon
rules.why: MEASURED 2026-09-07: these signatures hit 5 job types across 4 PRs, every one needing a re-run and none a code change
the gate could not be evaluated; a bare re-run reproduces the non-evaluation
a named assertion or gate miss is a RESULT; stop, record, do not retry
environment failure with no result in the log; re-run rather than edit code

research.question_shape: is this true / has it been done / what does the literature say

orchestration.question_shape: what should we do / in what order / does this merge

experiment.question_shape: this is broken and I cannot tell why
experiment.why: the answer is a measurement, not an opinion

operator.why: promotion, visibility, history rewrites stay with the human

escalation.note: an escalation that arrives without the receipt and the last log lines just costs a round trip
